source_authority: TAV-02S native raster/PDF through validated G1-G9 pipeline

physical_supports.rule: Physical support geometry is rectangular/extended geometry, not a point-node substitute.

analytical_nodes.rule: Beam joints are support-face nodes generated from documentary beam axes intersecting physical support faces; support centroids are not analytical nodes unless explicitly documented.

terrace_addition.rule: Preserve as later/documented addition and do not silently merge with the historical calculation model.

provenance_watches: P12 MIS Y and dependent nodes
downstream_consumption_rules: Use PT_MASTER_CURRENT.csv as the current PT support-level master.
Use PT_VECTOR_SUPPORTS_v1.csv for physical support extents and faces.
Use PT_ANALYTICAL_NODES_v1.csv for frame connectivity at support faces.
Use the effective beam topology PT_VECTOR_BEAMS_v2.csv plus PT_VECTOR_BEAMS_G6_PATCH_v1.csv.
Do not use PT_MASTER_PRE_G1G9_SNAPSHOT_20260821.csv as current geometry.
Do not reintroduce revoked B-029/B-044 or duplicate B-037 as a second physical member.
Do not collapse P18/P23/P30 to one centroid node.
Do not upgrade MIS/WATCH evidence to DOC without new primary-source evidence.
Reopen only individual claims contradicted by primary-source evidence; never restart G1-G9 wholesale.
